pr_title: Add analyzer to suggest top level route registration
pr_comments:
Could you add some docs for this, I didn't get what it was wanting me to do, finally I figured it out. Maybe docs like this:

***

**ASP0014**

x        | Description
--------|------
Code    | `ASP0014`
Title   | _Suggest using top level route registrations_
Message | _Suggest using top level route registrations instead of `UseEndpoints`_ (`UseEndpoints` will be filled in with whatever method is being used and should be replaced)
Name    | [`UseTopLevelRouteRegistrationsInsteadOfUseEndpoints`][asp-analyzer-cs]
Introduced | [PR #42937]
Source     | [`WebApplicationBuilderAnalyzer.cs`]
Tests      | [Tests][ASP0014-TEST]

Fix by replacing [`UseEndpoints`] with the same method calls directly on [`WebApplication`] which also implements [`IEndpointRouteBuilder`]

Example, old:
```cs
webApp.UseEndpoints(endpointRouteBuilder => {
    endpointRouteBuilder.MapGrpcService<MyService>();
});
```
Example, new:
```cs
webApp.MapGrpcService<MyService>();
```

Suppress via attribute:
```cs
[SuppressMessage("Usage", "ASP0014:Suggest using top level route registrations")]
```

[`IEndpointRouteBuilder`]: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.routing.iendpointroutebuilder
[`WebApplication`]: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.builder.webapplication
[`UseEndpoints`]: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.builder.endpointroutingapplicationbuilderextensions.useendpoints
[PR #42937]: https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/42937/
[ASP0014-TEST]: https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/42937/files/0c41eda09d10e70c5b9c3b5781abb61cc5980c73
[asp-analyzer-cs]: https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/src/Framework/AspNetCoreAnalyzers/src/Analyzers/DiagnosticDescriptors.cs
[`WebApplicationBuilderAnalyzer.cs`]: https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/src/Framework/AspNetCoreAnalyzers/src/Analyzers/WebApplicationBuilder/WebApplicationBuilderAnalyzer.cs





*****

I've seen this warning in my code and moved from endpoints to top level route.
This completely broke my app.
Can the docs/analyzers be improved so that this won't happen to other people or better explain how to change it so that it won't break the app API?
The following is the commit I did in order to revert back to a working state, I'd love to know what I did wrong in the first place and how to properly resolve the warning I get...
